verses.original: וּכְכַלּ֤וֹת שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וְהָאֵ֗שׁ יָֽרְדָה֙ מֵֽהַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתֹּ֥אכַל הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַזְּבָחִ֑ים וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה מָלֵ֥א אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḵal·lō·wṯ šə·lō·mōh lə·hiṯ·pal·lêl wə·hā·’êš yā·rə·ḏāh mê·haš·šā·ma·yim wat·tō·ḵal hā·‘ō·lāh wə·haz·zə·ḇā·ḥîm ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh mā·lê ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: When Solomon had finished praying fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices and the glory of the LORD filled the temple
verses.literalPt: E ACABANDO Salomão de orar, desceu o fogo do céu, e consumiu o holocausto e os sacrifícios; e a glória do SENHOR encheu a casa.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לָב֖וֹא אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־ מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm lā·ḇō·w ’el- bêṯ Yah·weh kî- mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priests were unable to enter . . . the house of the LORD because the glory of the LORD had filled it . . .
verses.literalPt: E os sacerdotes não podiam entrar na casa do SENHOR, porque a glória do SENHOR tinha enchido a casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹאִים֙ בְּרֶ֣דֶת הָאֵ֔שׁ וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּכְרְעוּ֩ אַפַּ֨יִם אַ֤רְצָה עַל־ הָרִֽצְפָה֙ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּֽחֲו֔וּ וְהוֹד֤וֹת לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl rō·’îm bə·re·ḏeṯ hā·’êš ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh ‘al- hab·bā·yiṯ way·yiḵ·rə·‘ū ’ap·pa·yim ’ar·ṣāh ‘al- hā·riṣ·p̄āh way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū wə·hō·w·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh kî ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: When all the Israelites . . . saw the fire coming down and the glory of the LORD above the temple they bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground and they worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD For He is good His loving devotion endures forever
verses.literalPt: E todos os filhos de Israel vendo descer o fogo, e a glória do SENHOR sobre a casa, encurvaram-se com o rosto em terra sobre o pavimento, e adoraram e louvaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Porque ele é bom, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.

verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām zō·ḇə·ḥîm ze·ḇaḥ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o rei e todo o povo ofereciam sacrifícios perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֮ אֶת־ זֶ֣בַח הַבָּקָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְצֹ֕אן מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וַֽיַּחְנְכוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְכָל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ hab·bā·qār ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ wə·ṣōn mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄ way·yaḥ·nə·ḵū ’eṯ- bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ham·me·leḵ wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of 22,000 . . . . . . oxen and 120,000 . . . . . . sheep So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God
verses.literalPt: E o rei Salomão ofereceu sacrifícios de bois, vinte e dois mil, e de ovelhas, cento e vinte mil; e o rei e todo o povo consagraram a casa de Deus.

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים עַל־ מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֣ם עֹמְדִ֗ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם בִּכְלֵי־ שִׁ֤יר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לְהֹד֤וֹת לַיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔וֹ בְּהַלֵּ֥ל דָּוִ֖יד בְּיָדָ֑ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ מַחֲצֹצְרִים נֶגְדָּ֔ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמְדִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘al- miš·mə·rō·w·ṯām ‘ō·mə·ḏîm wə·hal·wî·yim biḵ·lê- šîr Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh kî- lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw bə·hal·lêl dā·wîḏ bə·yā·ḏām wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm ma·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rīm neḡ·dām wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·mə·ḏîm
verses.literal: The priests stood at their posts as did the Levites with the musical instruments of the LORD which King David had made for giving thanks to the LORD and with which David had offered praise, saying For His loving devotion endures forever Across from the Levites the priests sounded trumpets and all the Israelites were standing
verses.literalPt: E os sacerdotes, serviam em seus ofícios; como também os levitas com os instrumentos musicais do SENHOR, que o rei Davi tinha feito, para louvarem ao SENHOR, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre, quando Davi o louvava pelo ministério deles; e os sacerdotes tocavam as trombetas diante deles, e todo o Israel estava em pé.

verses.original: וַיְקַדֵּ֣שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־ תּ֤וֹךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י בֵית־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ עָ֤שָׂה שָׁם֙ הָֽעֹל֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים כִּֽי־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לֹ֣א יָכ֗וֹל לְהָכִ֛יל אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַחֲלָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·qad·dêš šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- tō·wḵ he·ḥā·ṣêr ’ă·šer lip̄·nê ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kî- ‘ā·śāh šām hā·‘ō·lō·wṯ wə·’êṯ ḥel·ḇê haš·šə·lā·mîm kî- miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh lō yā·ḵō·wl lə·hā·ḵîl ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard in front of the house of the LORD and there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings since the bronze altar he had made could not hold all these offerings -
verses.literalPt: E Salomão santificou o meio do átrio, que estava diante da casa do SENHOR; porquanto ali tinha ele oferecido os holocaustos e a gordura dos sacrifícios pacíficos; porque no altar de metal, que Salomão tinha feito, não podia caber o holocausto, e a oferta de alimentos, e a gordura.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת־ הֶ֠חָג בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ קָהָ֖ל גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֑ד מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־ נַ֥חַל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- he·ḥāḡ bā·‘êṯ ha·hî šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘im·mōw qā·hāl gā·ḏō·wl mə·’ōḏ mil·lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ ‘aḏ- na·ḥal miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So at that time Solomon and all Israel with him a very great assembly of people from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt kept the feast for seven days
verses.literalPt: E, assim, naquele mesmo tempo celebrou Salomão a festa por sete dias e todo o Israel com ele, uma grande congregação, desde a entrada de Hamate, até ao rio do Egito.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י עֲצָ֑רֶת כִּ֣י׀ חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ עָשׂוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְהֶחָ֖ג שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū bay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî ‘ă·ṣā·reṯ kî ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ‘ā·śū šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·he·ḥāḡ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly for the dedication of the altar . . . had lasted seven days and the feast seven days more
verses.literalPt: E no dia oitavo realizaram uma assembléia solene; porque sete dias celebraram a consagração do altar, e sete dias a festa.

verses.original: וּבְי֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַל־ הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֣יד וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·lō·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šil·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lə·’ā·ho·lê·hem śə·mê·ḥîm wə·ṭō·w·ḇê lêḇ ‘al- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh lə·ḏā·wîḏ wə·liš·lō·mōh ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: On the twenty-third . . . day of the seventh month Solomon sent the people away to their homes joyful and glad of heart for the good things that the LORD had done for David for Solomon and for His people Israel
verses.literalPt: E no dia vigésimo terceiro do sétimo mês, despediu o povo para as suas tendas, alegres e de bom ânimo, pelo bem que o SENHOR tinha feito a Davi, e a Salomão, e a seu povo Israel.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֧ל שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ הַבָּ֜א עַל־ לֵ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֛ה וּבְבֵית֖וֹ הִצְלִֽיחַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- hab·bā ‘al- lêḇ šə·lō·mōh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ū·ḇə·ḇê·ṯōw hiṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: When Solomon had finished the house of the LORD and the royal palace successfully carrying out all that was in his heart to do for the house of the LORD and for his own palace
verses.literalPt: Assim Salomão acabou a casa do SENHOR, e a casa do rei, e tudo quanto Salomão intentou fazer na casa do SENHOR e na sua casa prosperamente o efetuou.

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ךָ וּבָחַ֜רְתִּי בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית זָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā Yah·weh ’el- šə·lō·mōh bal·lā·yə·lāh way·yō·mer lōw šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇā·ḥar·tî bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh lî lə·ḇêṯ zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: the LORD appeared to him at night and said to him I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for Myself as a house of sacrifice
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR apareceu de noite a Salomão, e disse-lhe: Ouvi a tua oração, e escolhi para mim este lugar para casa de sacrifício.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אֶֽעֱצֹ֤ר הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְהֵן־ אֲצַוֶּ֥ה עַל־ חָגָ֖ב לֶאֱכ֣וֹל הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאִם־ אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח דֶּ֖בֶר בְּעַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’e·‘ĕ·ṣōr haš·šā·ma·yim wə·lō- yih·yeh mā·ṭār wə·hên- ’ă·ṣaw·weh ‘al- ḥā·ḡāḇ le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’im- ’ă·šal·laḥ de·ḇer bə·‘am·mî
verses.literal: If I close the sky so there is no rain or if I command . . . the locust to devour the land or if I send a plague among My people
verses.literalPt: Se eu fechar os céus, e não houver chuva; ou se ordenar aos gafanhotos que consumam a terra; ou se enviar a peste entre o meu povo;

verses.original: וְיִכָּנְע֨וּ עַמִּ֜י אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־ שְׁמִ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְיִֽתְפַּֽלְלוּ֙ וִֽיבַקְשׁ֣וּ פָנַ֔י וְיָשֻׁ֖בוּ מִדַּרְכֵיהֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֑ים וַאֲנִי֙ אֶשְׁמַ֣ע מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְאֶסְלַח֙ לְחַטָּאתָ֔ם וְאֶרְפָּ֖א אֶת־ אַרְצָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yik·kā·nə·‘ū ‘am·mî ’ă·šer niq·rā- šə·mî ‘ă·lê·hem wə·yiṯ·pal·lū wî·ḇaq·šū p̄ā·nay wə·yā·šu·ḇū mid·dar·ḵê·hem hā·rā·‘îm wa·’ă·nî ’eš·ma‘ min- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’es·laḥ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām wə·’er·pā ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām
verses.literal: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways then I will hear from heaven forgive their sin and heal their land
verses.literalPt: E se o meu povo, que se chama pelo meu nome, se humilhar, e orar, e buscar a minha face e se converter dos seus maus caminhos, então eu ouvirei dos céus, e perdoarei os seus pecados, e sararei a sua terra.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה עֵינַי֙ יִהְי֣וּ פְתֻח֔וֹת וְאָזְנַ֖י קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִתְפִלַּ֖ת הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ‘ê·nay yih·yū p̄ə·ṯu·ḥō·wṯ wə·’ā·zə·nay qaš·šu·ḇō·wṯ liṯ·p̄il·laṯ ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now My eyes will be open and My ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place
verses.literalPt: Agora estarão abertos os meus olhos e atentos os meus ouvidos à oração deste lugar.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה בָּחַ֤רְתִּי וְהִקְדַּ֙שְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה לִהְיוֹת־ שְׁמִ֥י שָׁ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧י וְלִבִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh bā·ḥar·tî wə·hiq·daš·tî ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh lih·yō·wṯ- šə·mî šām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·hā·yū ‘ê·nay wə·lib·bî šām kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: For I have now chosen and consecrated this temple so that My Name may be there forever . . . My eyes and My heart will be there for all time . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque agora escolhi e santifiquei esta casa, para que o meu nome esteja nela perpetuamente; e nela estarão fixos os meus olhos e o meu coração todos os dias.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אִם־ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנַ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑יךָ וְחֻקַּ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּשְׁמֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’im- tê·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·nay ka·’ă·šer hā·laḵ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā wə·ḥuq·qay ū·miš·pā·ṭay tiš·mō·wr
verses.literal: And as for you if you walk before Me as your father David walked doing all I have commanded you and if you keep My statutes and ordinances
verses.literalPt: E, quanto a ti, se andares diante de mim, como andou Davi teu pai, e fizeres conforme a tudo o que te ordenei, e guardares os meus estatutos e os meus juízos,

verses.original: וַהֲקִ֣ימוֹתִ֔י אֵ֖ת כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּתֶ֑ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֗תִּי לְדָוִ֤יד אָבִ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qî·mō·w·ṯî ’êṯ kis·sê mal·ḵū·ṯe·ḵā ka·’ă·šer kā·rat·tî lə·ḏā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lê·mōr lō- yik·kā·rêṯ lə·ḵā ’îš mō·wō·šêl bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: then I will establish your royal throne as I covenanted with your father David when I said You will never fail to have a man to rule over Israel
verses.literalPt: Também confirmarei o trono do teu reino, conforme a aliança que fiz com Davi, teu pai, dizendo: Não te faltará sucessor que domine em Israel.

verses.original: וְאִם־ תְּשׁוּב֣וּן אַתֶּ֔ם וַעֲזַבְתֶּם֙ חֻקּוֹתַ֣י וּמִצְוֺתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- tə·šū·ḇūn ’at·tem wa·‘ă·zaḇ·tem ḥuq·qō·w·ṯay ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·ḵem wa·hă·laḵ·tem wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯem lā·hem
verses.literal: But if you turn away and forsake the statutes and commandments I have set before you and if you go off to serve and worship other gods
verses.literalPt: Porém se vós vos desviardes, e deixardes os meus estatutos, e os meus mandamentos, que vos tenho proposto, e fordes, e servirdes a outros deuses, e vos prostrardes a eles,

verses.original: וּנְתַשְׁתִּ֗ים מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִ֔י אַשְׁלִ֖יךְ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י וְאֶתְּנֶ֛נּוּ לְמָשָׁ֥ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּכָל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯaš·tîm mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯî ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem wə·’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer hiq·daš·tî liš·mî ’aš·lîḵ mê·‘al pā·nāy wə·’et·tə·nen·nū lə·mā·šāl wə·liš·nî·nāh bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: then I will uproot Israel from the soil I have given them and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name I will make it an object of scorn and ridicule among all the peoples
verses.literalPt: Então os arrancarei da minha terra que lhes dei, e lançarei da minha presença esta casa que consagrei ao meu nome, e farei com que seja por provérbio e motejo entre todos os povos.

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן לְכָל־ עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו יִשֹּׁ֑ם וְאָמַ֗ר בַּמֶּ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְלַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ‘el·yō·wn lə·ḵāl ‘ō·ḇêr ‘ā·lāw yiš·šōm wə·’ā·mar bam·meh ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh kā·ḵāh lā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·lab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble all who pass by it will be appalled and say Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple
verses.literalPt: E desta casa, que é tão exaltada, qualquer que passar por ela se espantará e dirá: Por que fez o SENHOR assim com esta terra e com esta casa?

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽזְב֜וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצִיאָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽיַּחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם וַיַּֽעַבְד֑וּם עַל־ כֵּן֙ הֵבִ֣יא עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ‘al ’ă·šer ‘ā·zə·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣî·’ām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·ya·ḥă·zî·qū bê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏūm ‘al- kên hê·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And others will answer Because they have forsaken the LORD the God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt and have embraced other gods worshiping and serving them because of this He has brought all this disaster upon them
verses.literalPt: E dirão: Porque deixaram ao SENHOR Deus de seus pais, que os tirou da terra do Egito, e se deram a outros deuses, e se prostraram a eles, e os serviram; por isso ele trouxe sobre eles todo este mal.
